arguments.sql:
WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT country, state, COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM main.alien_data
    GROUP BY country, state
    ORDER BY row_count DESC, country, state
    LIMIT 12
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.alien_data) AS total_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM main.alien_data) AS distinct_ids,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT QUOTE(aggressive)) FROM main.alien_data) AS stored_aggressive_values,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(age)) FROM main.alien_data) AS stored_age_types,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT QUOTE(country)) FROM main.alien_data) AS stored_countries,
    country,
    state,
    row_count
FROM state_counts
ORDER BY row_count DESC, country, state
